response.sql: WITH filtered_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM filtered_films GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rating_avg) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.rating_avg, ra.rating_avg - om.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ra.rating_avg > om.overall_avg
